title: Do It Yourself
question: Did the writer repair his lawn mower in the end? Why/Why not?

meanings.usage: 通常搭配介词for，表示对某事物的强烈喜爱
后接名词作宾语，常见搭配plead ignorance（声称不知情）
修饰动词，描述人做某事时愉快的状态
常搭配介词on/upon，指开始一项新的或重要的活动
搭配介词for，表示满足某人或某群体的需求
指在某一领域没有经验的人
常搭配介词for，表示释放某种情绪或能量的渠道
用来形容人善于应对各种困难
常搭配live under the delusion that，表示抱有错误的想法
指把机器、结构等拆成多个部件
常用来描述细线、链条等硬物突然折断

meanings.meaning: 难以克服的，无法解决的
meanings.usage: 常修饰问题、困难等，表示难度极大无法应对

meanings.meaning: 拼图游戏，错综复杂的事物
meanings.usage: jigsaw puzzle指拼图，也可比喻复杂难理清的情况
通常指反复抱怨或催促某人做某事

phrases.usage: 抽出时间做（一直想做的事）

examples.en: I've been meaning to fix the shelf, but I never got round to it.
examples.zh: 我一直想修那个架子，但始终抽不出时间做。

examples.en: They spent three months laying out their new garden.
examples.zh: 他们花了三个月布置新花园。

examples.en: Some fans go so far as to wait outside the hotel for hours just to see the star.
examples.zh: 一些粉丝甚至在酒店外等好几个小时，就为了看明星一眼。

examples.en: This restaurant caters for vegetarians with a special menu.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅有专门的菜单满足素食者的需求。

examples.en: He lives under the delusion that he can win the game without practice.
examples.zh: 他误以为不用练习就能赢得比赛。

phrases.usage: 请来，叫（专业人士）来帮忙

examples.en: We had to call in a plumber to fix the blocked pipe.
examples.zh: 我们不得不请水管工来修堵塞的管道。

examples.en: My mother would not hear of me walking home alone at night.
examples.zh: 我妈妈不同意我晚上独自走路回家。

examples.en: The floor was littered with toy bricks after the kids played.
examples.zh: 孩子们玩过之后，地板上散落着积木。

examples.en: Needless to say, the concert was canceled because of the bad weather.
examples.zh: 不用说，演唱会因为恶劣天气取消了。

sentences.en: So great is our passion for doing things for ourselves,
sentences.zh: 我们自己动手做事情的热情如此高涨，

sentences.en: that we are becoming increasingly less dependent on specialized labour.
sentences.zh: 以至于我们对专业劳动的依赖越来越少。

sentences.en: No one can plead ignorance of a subject any longer, for there are countless do-it-yourself publications.
sentences.zh: 任何人不能再声称对某事一无所知了，因为有无数的自己动手刊物。

sentences.en: Armed with the right tools and materials, newlyweds gaily embark on the task of decorating their own homes.
sentences.zh: 新婚夫妇带着合适的工具和材料，愉快地着手装饰自己的家园。

sentences.en: Men, particularly, spend hours of their leisure time installing their own fireplaces,
sentences.zh: 男人们，尤其是，花费数小时的闲暇时间安装自己的壁炉，

sentences.en: laying out their own gardens; building garages and making furniture.
sentences.zh: 布置自己的花园；建造车库和制作家具。

sentences.en: Some really keen enthusiasts go so far as to build their own computers.
sentences.zh: 一些真正热心的爱好者甚至自己组装电脑。

sentences.en: Shops cater for the do-it-yourself craze not only by running special advisory services for novices,
sentences.zh: 商店为了迎合这种自己动手热潮，不仅为新手提供专门的咨询服务，

sentences.en: but by offering consumers bits and pieces which they can assemble at home.
sentences.zh: 而且还向消费者提供他们可以在家组装的零配件。

sentences.en: Such things provide an excellent outlet for pent up creative energy, but unfortunately not all of us are born handymen.
sentences.zh: 这样的事情为积压的创造性精力提供了很好的发泄途径，但不幸的是，我们并非所有人都是天生的巧匠。

sentences.en: Some wives tend to believe that their husbands are infinitely resourceful and can fix anything.
sentences.zh: 一些妻子倾向于认为她们的丈夫足智多谋，什么都能修好。

sentences.en: Even men who can hardly drive a nail in straight are supposed to be born electricians, carpenters, plumbers and mechanics.
sentences.zh: 即使那些连钉子都钉不直的男人，也被认为是天生的电工、木匠、水管工和机械师。

sentences.en: When lights fuse, furniture gets rickety, pipes get clogged, or vacuum cleaners fail to operate,
sentences.zh: 当灯泡烧坏、家具摇晃、管道堵塞或吸尘器无法工作时，

sentences.en: some women assume that their husbands will somehow put things right.
sentences.zh: 一些女人会认为她们的丈夫总会把事情弄好。

sentences.en: The worst thing about the do-it-yourself game is that sometimes even men live under the delusion that they can do anything,
sentences.zh: 自己动手游戏的糟糕之处在于，有时连男人也活在自己无所不能的错觉中，

sentences.en: even when they have repeatedly been proved wrong.
sentences.zh: 即使他们一再被证明是错的。

sentences.en: It is a question of pride as much as anything else.
sentences.zh: 这更多的是一个面子问题。

sentences.en: Last spring my wife suggested that I call in a man to look at our lawn mower.
sentences.zh: 去年春天，我妻子建议我请人来修理我们的割草机。

sentences.en: It had broken down the previous summer, and though I promised to repair it, I had never got round to it.
sentences.zh: 它在前一个夏天坏了，虽然我答应修理，但一直没空动手。

sentences.en: I would not hear of the suggestion and said that I would fix it myself.
sentences.zh: 我不听她的建议，说我会自己修好它。

sentences.en: One Saturday afternoon, I hauled the machine into the garden and had a close look at it.
sentences.zh: 一个星期六下午，我把机器拖到花园里仔细查看。

sentences.en: As far as I could see, it needed only a minor adjustment:
sentences.zh: 据我所见，它只需要做一些小调整：

sentences.en: a turn of a screw here, a little tightening up there, a drop of oil and it would be as good as new.
sentences.zh: 这里拧一下螺丝，那里紧一紧，再滴一滴油，就会焕然一新。

sentences.en: Inevitably the repair job was not quite so simple.
sentences.zh: 不可避免地，这项修理工作远没有那么简单。

sentences.en: The mower firmly refused to mow, so I decided to dismantle it.
sentences.zh: 割草机坚决不肯割草，所以我决定把它拆开。

sentences.en: The garden was soon littered with chunks of metal which had once made up a lawn mower.
sentences.zh: 花园里很快就散落着曾经组成割草机的金属碎片。

sentences.en: But I was extremely pleased with myself. I had traced the cause of the trouble.
sentences.zh: 但我对自己非常满意。我找到了故障的原因。

sentences.en: One of the links in the chain that drives the wheels had snapped.
sentences.zh: 驱动车轮的链条上的一环断裂了。

sentences.en: After buying a new chain I was faced with the insurmountable task of putting the confusing jigsaw puzzle together again.
sentences.zh: 买了一条新链条后，我面临着一项无法克服的任务：把这个令人困惑的拼图重新组装起来。

sentences.en: I was not surprised to find that the machine still refused to work after I had reassembled it,
sentences.zh: 我重新组装好机器后，发现它仍然无法工作，对此我并不感到惊讶，

sentences.en: for the simple reason that I was left with several curiously shaped bits of metal which did not seem to fit anywhere.
sentences.zh: 理由很简单，我剩下了一些形状奇特的金属零件，似乎哪里也安不上。

sentences.en: I gave up in despair.
sentences.zh: 我绝望地放弃了。

sentences.en: The weeks passed and the grass grew.
sentences.zh: 几周过去了，草长高了。

sentences.en: When my wife nagged me to do something about it,
sentences.zh: 当我妻子唠叨我该做些什么时，

sentences.en: I told her that either I would have to buy a new mower or let the grass grow.
sentences.zh: 我告诉她，要么我买一台新割草机，要么就让草长着。

sentences.en: Needless to say our house is now surrounded by a jungle.
sentences.zh: 不用说，我们的房子现在被一片丛林包围着。

sentences.en: Buried somewhere in deep grass there is a rusting lawn mower which I have promised to repair one day.
sentences.zh: 某个地方，在深草丛中埋着一台生锈的割草机，我曾承诺有一天会把它修好。

exercises.prompt: “拆卸，拆开” 对应的单词是？

source.en: The worst thing about the do-it-yourself game is that sometimes even men live under the delusion that they can do anything,

exercises.prompt: “当so+形容词/副词位于句首表示强调时，句子需要部分倒装，用来加强语气” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: So + adj./adv. + be动词/助动词/情态动词 + 主语 + that + 结果状语从句
options: 虚拟语气在suggest后的宾语从句中的用法
It seems that 主语从句结构
exercises.explain: so...that...引导的倒装句：So + adj./adv. + be动词/助动词/情态动词 + 主语 + that + 结果状语从句：用于强调形容词或副词所描述的程度，引出后面的结果

exercises.prompt:
选出下面句子的正确中文意思：
even when they have repeatedly been proved wrong.
options: 我问一位乘客这是否是韦斯特黑文特快，但他甚至没有听说过。
即使他们一再被证明是错的。
在凌晨4点15分进行了一次短程试飞后，布莱里奥在半小时后出发了。
似乎她肯定会是第一艘抵达的船，
exercises.explain: even when they have repeatedly been proved wrong. — 即使他们一再被证明是错的。

source.en: even when they have repeatedly been proved wrong.

grammar.title: so...that...引导的倒装句
grammar.definition: 当so+形容词/副词位于句首表示强调时，句子需要部分倒装，用来加强语气
grammar.structure: So + adj./adv. + be动词/助动词/情态动词 + 主语 + that + 结果状语从句
grammar.usage: 用于强调形容词或副词所描述的程度，引出后面的结果

examples.en: So great is our passion for doing things for ourselves, that we are becoming increasingly less dependent on specialized labour.
examples.zh: 我们自己动手的热情是如此高涨，以至于我们越来越不依赖专业劳动力。

examples.en: So fast did he run that no one could catch up with him.
examples.zh: 他跑得太快了，没人能追上他。

grammar.title: 虚拟语气在suggest后的宾语从句中的用法
grammar.definition: 当suggest表示“建议”时，后面的宾语从句需要用虚拟语气，即谓语动词为should+动词原形，should可以省略
grammar.structure: 主语 + suggest + that + 主语 + (should) + 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.usage: 用于表达建议、要求、命令等含义的动词后的宾语从句中

examples.en: Last spring my wife suggested that I call in a man to look at our lawn mower.
examples.zh: 去年春天，我妻子建议我请个人来看看我们的割草机。

examples.en: The teacher suggested that we (should) finish the project before Friday.
examples.zh: 老师建议我们在周五之前完成这个项目。

original.en: Some really keen enthusiasts go so far as to build their own computers.
original.zh: 一些真正热衷的人甚至自己组装电脑。

examples.en: Some pet owners go so far as to buy expensive clothes for their cats.
examples.zh: 一些宠物主人甚至给他们的猫买昂贵的衣服。

examples.en: Some students go so far as to stay up all night to prepare for the exam.
examples.zh: 一些学生甚至通宵复习准备考试。

original.en: The worst thing about the do-it-yourself game is that sometimes even men live under the delusion that they can do anything.
original.zh: 自己动手最糟糕的一点是，有时候就连男人们也会误以为自己什么都能做。

examples.en: The worst thing about travelling alone is that you have no one to share the beautiful scenery with.
examples.zh: 独自旅行最糟糕的一点是，你没有人可以分享美丽的风景。

examples.en: The worst thing about forgetting your phone is that you can't contact anyone when you need help.
examples.zh: 忘带手机最糟糕的一点是，你需要帮助的时候联系不上任何人。

patterns.pattern: As far as I could see, it needed only...

original.en: As far as I could see, it needed only a minor adjustment: a turn of a screw here, a little tightening up there, a drop of oil and it would be as good as new.
original.zh: 在我看来，它只需要一点小小的调整：这里拧一下螺丝，那里紧一紧，滴点油，就会跟新的一样了。

examples.en: As far as I could see, the cake needed only a little more cream on top to be perfect.
examples.zh: 在我看来，这个蛋糕只需要在顶部多加一点奶油就完美了。

examples.en: As far as I could see, the plan needed only a few small changes to be workable.
examples.zh: 在我看来，这个计划只需要几处小改动就可行了。

patterns.pattern: When..., I told her that either...or...

original.en: When my wife nagged me to do something about it, I told her that either I would have to buy a new mower or let the grass grow.
original.zh: 当我妻子催我想想办法的时候，我告诉她要么我买个新的割草机，要么就让草继续长。

examples.en: When my friend asked where to have dinner, I told her that either we can eat at the new restaurant nearby or order takeout.
examples.zh: 当我朋友问去哪里吃晚饭的时候，我告诉她要么我们去附近的新餐厅吃，要么点外卖。

examples.en: When the teacher asked about our weekend plan, I said that either we would visit the museum or go hiking.
examples.zh: 当老师问起我们的周末计划时，我说我们要么去参观博物馆，要么去远足。
